en: Vintage Romanian postcard showing a large spa-sanatorium building with arcades and a pitched roof. On the façade are socialist slogans including "TRĂIASCĂ PARTIDUL MUNCITORESC," and atop the roof the letters "PMR" beside a star. The reverse bears Romanian and Cyrillic printed headings, blue handwritten Romanian text and an address to Bucharest, with Bucharest postmarks dated 1954.
